description: Three separate detectors, each putting out a gate while the voltage patched into it is changing

params.text: Sets a window in volts around the last sample, 0V to 1V; at 0V the gate is high whenever the voltage differs from the last sample, and above 0V it is high while the voltage stays inside the window

inputs.text: The voltage to be watched for change, one per channel

outputs.text: Carries 10V on a channel whose voltage met the test on this sample and 0V on the rest

notes: the three detectors share nothing, so each needs its own cable
